conference.title: Inclusive Design Summit
conference.help: Ask the welcome desk for help finding a room or getting event information.

rooms.name: Main Hall
rooms.guidance: Enter through the north doors and follow the wide green floor markers to Main Hall.

rooms.name: Workshop Studio
rooms.guidance: From the welcome desk, follow the blue signs past Main Hall to the Workshop Studio.

sessions.title: Start with the people: an inclusive design foundation
sessions.summary: Explore how to notice barriers early, learn from people with different experiences, and make access part of the first design decisions.
sessions.nextAction: Follow the green floor markers to Main Hall before 9:00 AM.

sessions.title: Make digital services usable by more people
sessions.summary: Walk through practical ways to make content clearer, support keyboard use, and check common tasks with assistive technology.
sessions.nextAction: Follow the blue signs to Workshop Studio before 10:30 AM.

sessions.title: Wayfinding that welcomes everyone
sessions.summary: Look at signs, maps, landmarks, and room information that help more people find their next step at an event.
sessions.nextAction: Follow the green floor markers to Main Hall before 12:00 PM.
